blocks.text: Belcris Foods Inc. is running its Pasko sa Kabataan initiative for the second consecutive year, partnering with Parent’s REACH Foundation Inc. for a holiday eco-bag design contest with the theme “The Colors of Christmas.” Thirty-one children on the autism spectrum from Parent’s REACH Foundation are participating, with three winning designs selected as the official artwork for Belcris’ Christmas 2026 eco-bags. Selected elements from the top three entries will also appear in the company’s ham brochure. Understanding Christmas through the colors of children with autism The contest asks participating children to interpret Christmas through their own visual expression, with the resulting artwork […]...
